blind.description: A pile of collapsed, weathered wooden beams snapped at the center with exposed pale splintered breaks and prominent rusty iron bolts, resting upon a scattered bed of loose dark grey rubble and small stone fragments. The wood surfaces feature dark aged stain with subtle greenish moss patches, and all geometry forms a solid, low-lying ground prop with no floating elements.
blind.from_above: Two broken wooden beams intersecting in a rough X-shape with light-toned splintered breaks at their center point, set atop an irregular cluster of dark grey rubble and stones.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1 to 1.5 feet tall (roughly one-quarter to one-fifth the height of the figure) and roughly 3.5 to 4 feet wide.

notes: Footprint is squarer than catalog estimate due to the X-crossing angle of the beams
